import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { db, auth } from "../firebase"; // Adjust the path as needed import { doc, getDoc } from "firebase/firestore"; import { Card, CardBody, CardTitle, Container, Row, Col } from "reactstrap"; const Header = () => { const [userData, setUserData] = useState({ carbonFootprint: 0, carbonCredits: 0, reductionProgress: 0, rank: 0, }); useEffect(() => { const fetchUserData = async () => { if (auth.currentUser) { const userRef = doc(db, "users", auth.currentUser.uid); const userSnap = await getDoc(userRef); if (userSnap.exists()) { setUserData(userSnap.data()); } } }; fetchUserData(); }, []); return ( <>
{/* Card stats */}
Carbon Footprint (kg CO₂) {userData.carbonFootprint} kg
Carbon Credits Earned {userData.carbonCredits}
Carbon Reduction Progress (%) {userData.reductionProgress}%
Rank {userData.rank}
); }; export default Header;
